People: John Bowring (translator, Wikidata Q332508), died 1872; Vuk Stefanović Karadžić (other, Wikidata Q202815), died 1864. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Bowring, John, 1792-1872 [Translator]; Karadžić, Vuk Stefanović, 1787-1864 [Compiler]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Servian Popular Poetry, Printed for the author, 1827, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/servianpopularp02bowrgoog. The scan does not show the credit of Vuk Stefanović Karadžić, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
